info.title: BuildFlow local demonstrator API
info.description: Executable loopback-only portfolio API. X-Demo-Role is NOT authentication. Target production uses Entra OAuth and scoped RBAC; production evidence scanning, throttling and ERP connector are not implemented. Commands require Idempotency-Key and expectedVersion where specified. Financial amounts are integer EUR cents.

parameters.description: Local unauthenticated role simulation only; production derives authority from Entra.
